items.title: Shapes of alkanes and cycloalkanes (printed as a second 11.2.3) (alkanes aur cycloalkanes ki shapes) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Shapes of Alkanes and Cycloalkanes, printed as a second 11.2.3, pages 249-251.

blocks.text: Alkane ke carbon atom ke chaar sp³ hybridized orbitals hote hain aur woh chaar single bonds banata hai jo aik doosre se barabar faasle par hote hain (Figure 11.4). Is liye alkane molecules mein har carbon atom ke gird shape tetrahedral (chaar corners wali, teen-sided pyramid jaisi) hoti hai.
Alkane molecules mein carbon atoms apne ird gird ke carbon aur hydrogen atoms ke saath sigma bonds banate hain.

Is wajah se alkanes mein har carbon atom ke gird bonding electrons ke 4 pairs hote hain jo aik doosre ko barabar dhakelte (repel karte) hain. Is se 109.5° ke bond angles bante hain, aur C–C bond length 1.54 Å hoti hai. Organic molecules ki shapes aam taur par ball and stick formula (gend aur dandi wale model) se dikhai jati hain. Kuch seedhi chain wale alkanes ki shapes Table 11.4 mein hain.

blocks.alt: Orbital diagram. Methane: darmiyani C se chaar neele sp3 lobes, har ek ke end par peela H; do lobes ke darmiyan arc (qaus) par 109.5 degree; 'sp3 hybrid tetrahedral'. Ethane: do carbons, har ek ke teen lobes H tak, aur dono carbons ke darmiyan do lobes seedha (end-on) overlap karte hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.4: sp3 hybridised methane aur ethane (kitab ki Figure 11.4 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.alt: Methane (oopar) aur ethane (neeche) ke ball-and-stick models. Methane mein chaar hydrogen carbon ke gird tetrahedron ke konon par hain, aur red arc 109.5 degree ka bond angle dikhati hai. Ethane mein do carbon purple C-C sigma bond se jure hain aur har carbon par teen hydrogen hain. Har C-H bond par orange shade sp3-s sigma overlap dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: sp3 hybridised methane aur ethane: hamara apna 3D model (kitab ki Figure 11.4 oopar 2D diagram mein hai; ghuma kar har taraf se dekhein).
blocks.long_description: Carbon apna 2s aur teen 2p orbitals mila kar chaar barabar sp3 orbitals banata hai jo tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf 109.5 degree ke fasle par hain. Methane mein har sp3 orbital hydrogen ke 1s orbital se seedha (end-on) overlap kar ke chaar C-H sigma bonds banata hai. Ethane mein har carbon ka aik sp3 orbital end-on overlap se C-C sigma bond banata hai aur baqi teen hydrogen se judte hain, kul chhe C-H sigma bonds.

fallback.text: Methane aur ethane: har carbon sp3 hai, us ke chaar sigma bonds tetrahedron ke konon ki taraf 109.5 degree ke fasle par hain.
fallback.alt: 3D model ki picture: sp3 hybridised methane aur ethane.

blocks.alt: Teen columns wali table: IUPAC naam aur molecular formula, structural formula, 3D structure. Rows: methane CH4, ethane C2H6, propane C3H8, butane C4H10. Har structural formula mein har C-H aur C-C bond dikhaya gaya hai: carbons aik seedhi line mein, H oopar, neeche aur dono kinaron par. 3D structure ball-and-stick model hai: grey gend carbon, safaid gend hydrogen; propane aur butane ki carbon chain zig-zag hai.
blocks.caption: Table 11.4 Kuch seedhi chain wale alkanes ki shapes (kitab ki Table 11.4 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Beech wale column mein har bond aik line hai, is liye har carbon ke chaar bonds gin sakte hain. 3D model mein grey gend carbon aur safaid gend hydrogen hai, aur dandi (stick) bond hai. Har carbon ke gird bonds tetrahedral (109.5°) hain, is liye lambi chain seedhi nahi balkay zig-zag dikhti hai.

Cycloalkanes cyclic hain, yani molecule ke carbon atoms aik ring (halqa) ki shakal mein lage hote hain. Cycloalkanes saturated bhi hain, yani ring ke tamam carbon atoms doosre atoms se sirf single bonds se jure hain. Cyclopropane, cyclobutane aur cyclopentane ki shapes Table 11.5 mein hain.

blocks.alt: Teen columns wali table: IUPAC naam aur molecular formula, structural formula, 3D structure. Rows: cyclopropane C3H6 (CH2 groups ka triangle), cyclobutane C4H8 (CH2 groups ka square), cyclopentane jis ka formula kitab mein C4H10 chhapa hai, red mein (paanch CH2 groups ka ring). 3D structure ball-and-stick model hai: grey carbon gend shaded ring mein, har carbon par do safaid hydrogen gend.
blocks.caption: Table 11.5 Kuch cycloalkanes ki shapes (kitab ki Table 11.5 jaisa original diagram; red formula kitab mein aise chhapa hai, sahi C₅H₁₀ hai, neeche dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Table 11.5 mein cyclopentane ka formula C₄H₁₀ chhapa hai. Cyclopentane ke ring mein 5 carbon hain aur cycloalkane ka formula CₙH₂ₙ hota hai, is liye sahi formula C₅H₁₀ hai (C₄H₁₀ to butane hai).

items: Alkane ka carbon: sp³, chaar sigma bonds, tetrahedral, 109.5°, C–C 1.54 Å.
Cycloalkanes saturated ring hain: cyclopropane C₃H₆, cyclobutane C₄H₈, cyclopentane C₅H₁₀.
